title: Fushimi Inari at first light · Kiyomizu · Nishiki · Santa Parade in Umekita · Gion lanterns, duck hot-pot and Kiyamachi

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Out the door at 06:00 with passports; today is day 1 of the JR Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass (exchange it at a JR office beforehand), so activate it at the first JR gate. Breakfast is konbini onigiri and coffee on the train.
stops.transport: Hanshin Namba line Kujō → Nishikujō, JR Loop line → Osaka (grab konbini breakfast in the 10-min change), JR Kyoto line special rapid → Kyoto, JR Nara line → Inari, then walk up through the Rōmon gate; JR legs on the pass, about 115 min door to door

stops.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
stops.plan: Senbon Torii in the low winter morning light before the tour groups, then push up to the Yotsutsuji viewpoint over Kyoto and back down.
stops.transport: Taxi, 2 cars, 21 min to the Kiyomizu-zaka drop-off (about ¥2,800 per car); the train plus the uphill walk takes over an hour

stops.name: Kiyomizu-dera
stops.plan: The wooden stage over the bare winter maples and the city view; a quick sip at Otowa-no-taki on the way out.
stops.transport: Walk down from the temple gate into Sannenzaka, 8 min

stops.name: Sannenzaka & Ninenzaka
stops.plan: Walk the stone-stepped slopes down toward Yasaka; snack and souvenir stops only, keep moving.
stops.transport: Walk via Yasaka Shrine and Shijō-dōri over the Kamo river to Nishiki, about 28 min

stops.name: Nishiki Market
stops.plan: Graze lunch along the 400 m: tamagoyaki, tako-tamago, soy-milk doughnuts, skewers; eat at each stall, not while walking.
stops.transport: Hankyu Kyoto line limited express Karasuma → Osaka-umeda, walk to Umekita, about 70 min

stops.name: Grand Santa Parade in UMEKITA
stops.plan: Check in, suit up as 8 of about 500 Santas and parade through Umekita handing out presents; START TIME AND MEETING POINT NOT YET ANNOUNCED: register all 8 the day sign-up opens in early November and re-time this block to the confirmed slot. Fallback if it fills or is cancelled: own Santa suits from Donki, the Grand Wish tree show and LUCUA/Nintendo OSAKA in the same window.
stops.price: Free (2025 terms; suit yours to keep)
stops.transport: Walk to the Grand Front North Building tree, 4 min

stops.name: GRAND WISH CHRISTMAS tree show and Umekita gold illumination
stops.plan: Still in the suits: catch a quarter-hour tree show and the group photo under the gold-lit Umekita lawn.
stops.transport: Hankyu Kyoto line limited express Osaka-umeda → Kyoto-kawaramachi, walk to Shirakawa, about 72 min

stops.name: Gion Shirakawa & Tatsumi-bashi
stops.plan: The willow canal and Tatsumi bridge lit by teahouse lanterns, then cut down Hanamikoji on the way to Pontochō; keep voices down and leave the maiko alone.
stops.transport: Walk via Hanamikoji and over Shijō-ōhashi into Pontochō, 9 min

stops.name: Pontochō Robin
stops.plan: Kamo-nabe duck hot-pot course in the old townhouse, zashiki room for all 8 (book the 19:15 slot on TableCheck; fallback: Kiyamachi izakaya walk-in).
stops.transport: Walk one block west to Kiyamachi, 4 min

stops.name: Kiyamachi-dori bar strip
stops.plan: Cheap canal-side standing bars between Shijō and Sanjō; two rounds, then out by 22:30 for the 22:50 Keihan from Sanjō.
stops.transport: Walk to Sanjō, Keihan limited express 22:50 → Kitahama, Metro Sakaisuji line → Sakaisuji-Hommachi, Chūō line → Kujō, about 93 min (Hankyu Kawaramachi → Umeda is the backup)

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Home; Hiroshima train leaves early tomorrow.
